_comment: Manual review of institution names that the deterministic key did not unify but fuzzy matching flagged. Rule applied: merge only when the institution name differs by spelling/abbreviation AND the location matches (or the name is distinctive and no location conflicts). Generic names (e.g. 'Government Polytechnic') need a matching city. Everything not listed as 'merge' stays separate.
